newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria cuts main interest rate to 16.30 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria cuts main interest rate to 16.30 percent.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) will cut its main interest rate to an effective annual 16.30 percent calculated through accumulation of the monthly accruals from 42.24 percent now, dealers said on Friday.
"The central bank informed us that it will set its main interest rate at an effective annual 16.30 percent, from Monday," a commercial bank dealer told Reuters.
The BNB has not advised under what simple monthly interest rate the new effective annual main rate was calculated, the dealer said.
BNB officials were not immediately available for comment. An official statement could be expected later on Friday after a BNB board meeting, currently underway, is over.
The current effective annual main interest rate of 42.24 percent was calculated under a simple annual rate of 35.76 percent or 2.98 percent a month.
